مُنْتَفِشٌ : see مَنْفُوشٌ.―
-b2- ?? A female slave having shaggy or dishevelled hair: (A;) شَعْتآءُ. (K) ―
-b3- ?? is likewise applied to anything Swollen, or humid, and loose or flaccid or soft within; as also ↓ مُتَعّشٌ . (Az, K.) ―
-b4- You say also أَنْفٌ مُنْتفِشٌ (tropical:) A nose short in the مَارِن [is soft part], and spreading upon the face, like the nose of the زَنْجِىّ] (A;) and ?? has the like signification; as also ↓ ?? ; (TA;) or in means are cad of a nose spreading upon the face: (K:) and ↓ مُتَبَفّشُ المُنْخِريْنِ, in like manner, wide in the two nostrils. (TA.) See also مُنَتَفّسٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
